pride_search_note: PRIDE archive v2 /search/projects in this environment returns recent submissions regardless of queryString (free-text relevance ranking non-functional); PRIDE search backend not usable at tractable size.
reason_not_executed: A large number of SAH/ICH/stroke GEO cohorts are transcriptomic (RNA-seq/miRNA/ATAC), not proteomic. The genuinely proteomic Olink/SomaScan/LC-MS plasma cohorts deposited on GEO are all non-cerebrovascular (atherosclerosis, sepsis, glomerular disease, Down syndrome, AF). No openly-downloadable, parseable-at-tractable-size plasma/serum proteomics case-vs-control in SAH/aSAH/ICH/acute-ischemic-stroke that measures HP/HMOX1/FTH1/FTL/CD163/TFRC/SLC40A1 was located. Per integrity rule 3 no proxy was substituted for the requested analysis; Fig 30 is therefore skipped.
fallback_note: Task 2 (GSE269478) does provide a genuine PROTEIN (CITE-seq ADT) read of CD163/MRC1/HLA-DR -- but in healthy human monocytes, single-cell surface protein, NOT plasma bulk levels of the heme proteins in patients; it does not and is not labelled as the SAH patient-protein-level proof the reviewer asked for.
conclusion: No fabricated numbers. Protein-level SAH/stroke plasma corroboration remains an open gap; it requires a patient plasma Olink/SomaScan LC-MS cohort that is not openly available in these repositories at tractable size.
